cases.question: How do I make Le Tourin garlic soup?

response.answer: Le Tourin is a garlic soup from the village of Le Fleix in Dordogne, serving 2 and taking about 30 minutes. Brown the chopped garlic in olive oil in a frying pan, add the flour and cook a few minutes to remove the floury taste, then gradually stir in the water and cook for 10 minutes. Beat the egg white, temper it with a ladleful of soup, and stir it back into the pot. Combine the egg yolk, pepper and vinegar, temper the yolks with a ladleful of soup, then remove the pot from the heat, stir in the yolk mixture and season with salt. Place thin slices of bread in each bowl, pour the soup on top and serve hot. Ingredients: 10–12 cloves garlic, chopped; 1 tablespoon olive oil; 1 tablespoon flour; 4 cups water, or as needed; 1 egg, separated; pepper to taste; 1 teaspoon vinegar; salt to taste. cases.question: What's the method for pasta carbonara?

response.answer: The first recipe, Spaghetti alla Carbonara, is made as follows. Dice 225–500 g of guanciale or pancetta into 2.5 cm pieces. Bring a big pot of water to a boil and add salt when it begins to simmer. Cook 450 g spaghetti until al dente, drain it, and reserve 1 cup of the cooking water. While the pasta cooks, heat 3–4 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the pork, and cook about 10 minutes over low heat until it has rendered most of its fat but is still chewy and barely browned. In a bowl, slowly whisk about ½ cup of the pasta water into 5 egg yolks, then add ¾ cup grated Pecorino Romano and ¾ cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano and mix thoroughly with a fork. Transfer the hot spaghetti immediately to the skillet, toss, and turn off the heat. Add the egg and cheese mixture, stirring in the remaining pasta water to thin the sauce and create an emulsion. Add ½ tablespoon freshly ground pepper and toss to coat. A variant, Carbonara Pasta, uses 4 eggs, 3 oz fresh pancetta, thyme and lemon zest, and combines the cooled pork and yolks in a bowl before adding the drained pasta. The ingredient list comes from the source page and may be incomplete.

cases.question: How do I make rice pudding without raisins?

response.answer: The Italian Rice Pudding recipe makes a rice pudding with no raisins in its ingredient list. Start by bringing 2 cups (500 ml) water to a boil, then add 1 cup (110 g) risotto rice, ¼ teaspoon salt, and 1 tablespoon butter. Cover, lower the heat to simmer, and cook for 20 minutes. Place the rice in the upper part of a double boiler with 3 cups (750 ml) half and half, 1 cup (225 g) granulated sugar, 1 cinnamon stick, and 1 piece of lemon peel. Bring to a boil over direct heat, then place over simmering water in the double boiler and cook for 45 minutes. Remove the cinnamon stick and lemon peel, pour the mixture into a 2-quart (1.9 L) casserole, allow it to cool, and sprinkle with ground cinnamon. The mixture will thicken as it cools and is best at room temperature or slightly warm. The ingredient list comes from the source page and may be incomplete.
